literature: Guilmin/Rouchon/Tilloy arXiv2212.00176v2, Eqs46,50,57,63–66; general tilted-generator method KNOWN, application here DERIVED conditional.

assumptions.bath: Independent bosonic Markov vacuum input channels and a chosen unitary/dilation realization; not inferred solely from generator L.
assumptions.monitored_ports: Li=sqrt(kappa_in) ai and Lo=sqrt(kappa_out) ao; ideal efficiency=1, calibrated common phase references. Other3dissipators unmonitored but retained.
assumptions.output: homodyne dY_j normalized as quadrature dX_j=dY_j/sqrt2; shot noise dX_j dX_k=delta_jk dt/2.
assumptions.preparation: Same finite2x2x2 state and fullGKLS; no identification of actual physical wave packets/patent hardware claimed.

formulas.ordered: t>s: E[I_j(t)I_k(s)]regular=Tr M_j exp((t-s)L) M_k rho(s). Reverse time by exchanging detector/time labels; same-time singular part delta_jk delta(t-s)/2.
formulas.filtered: Qj=integral_0^T f_j(t)dX_j(t); real L2-normalized filters. Two times, not instantaneous cavity C/B.
formulas.v: v_jk_dot=L v_jk+f_j M_j u_k+f_k M_k u_j+delta_jk*f_j*f_k*rho/2, v_jk(0)=0
formulas.moments: E Qj=Tr uj; E QjQk=Tr vjk; centered covariance subtracts means. Keep rho,u,v as full matrices, no factorization.
formulas.LO_frame: If R L R†=exp(-i chi)L and rho_rot=R rho_lab R†, R M_theta_lab(rho_lab)R†=M_(theta_lab+chi)(rho_rot). Thus matched LO theta_lab=theta0-omega_d*t gives constant theta_rot; no silent frequency relabel or internal clock inference.

reuse.liouvillian: Call existing liouvillian(h,jumps). No new generator or64-moment closure. Augment only known filtered momentODE.
reuse.source_execution: Never execute/import original main; import only the previously AST-extracted pure helper file.

analytic_controls.single_emission: Separate2level model H=0,L=sqrt(kappa)a,kappa=1,T=1,initial|1>; normalized matched filter f=sqrt(kappa)*exp(-kappa*t/2)/sqrt(p),p=1-exp(-kappa*T). E Q=0,E Q²=1/2+p.
analytic_controls.two_ports: Separate two-mode independent damping kappa=1 each, initial(|00>+exp(i*pi/4)|11>)/sqrt2; same matched filters. Reconstruct output C=p*exp(i*pi/4)/2,B=0 from four distinct phase settings.
analytic_controls.ordering: Single-emission t=.8,s=.2,theta=0: regular correlation=kappa exp[-kappa(t+s)/2]. Wrong rho(t) in place rho(s) must differ>1e-5.
analytic_controls.noise_mutation: Vacuum control with shotnoise term omitted gives0, must differ from1/2 by>1e-5.
analytic_controls.LO_mutation: Wrong imaginary sign in decoder on two-port control must differ from expected C by>1e-5.

full_case.status: INPUT same parameter set fromR62; no fitting
full_case.parameters_from: PREPARED_READOUT_PLAN_R62.json model parameters; gammaLambda=1; beta computed from pinned ALPHA_FINE_CODATA_2018*sqrt(e) at runtime.
full_case.channels: Four phase settings in separate identical preparations; never X/P simultaneous outcomes in one run.
outputs: C_filtered andB_filtered byR62algebra; no equality toinstantaneoussystemC/B
full_case.pass: All analytical controls within1e-8; matrixidentities1e-12; states/imaginary parts1e-9; negativecontrols recognized>1e-5. Fixed before run.

limits: No bosonic GKLS intertwining, Poincare covariance or physical detector installation.
Bath/dilation, ports, efficiency, filters andLO reference are named INPUT.
No repeatedR62/R63campaign and no removal of fullcase pump/losses.
